members.description: Additional CSS classes merged into the date trigger button.

members.name: update:modelValue
members.description: Emitted when a date is selected, confirmed, or cleared, updating v-model. Clearing emits null.

members.name: open
members.description: Emitted when the panel state becomes open. Its displayed selection is reinitialized from the current modelValue.

members.name: close
members.description: Emitted when the panel state becomes closed.

members.name: update:open
members.description: Emitted when the component requests an open-state update for v-model:open. In controlled mode, the parent must update open to change the displayed state.

members.name: change
members.description: Emitted immediately on confirmation or clearing. On other closes, it is emitted only if the panel selection and the current modelValue have different timestamps.

members.name: open
members.description: A writable reference to the panel open state. Assigning through the component instance requests opening or closing; readonly blocks opening requests. Controlled writes emit update:open and require the parent to update open.

members.name: modelValue
members.description: The Date representing the selected year and initializing the viewed decade. Clearing returns the view to the decade containing the current year.

members.name: minDate
members.description: The lower bound used to disable year buttons. A year is disabled when its December 31 precedes this value. Selection retains the base month and day instead of clamping the full date to the bound.

members.name: maxDate
members.description: The upper bound used to disable year buttons. A year is disabled when its January 1 follows this value. Selection retains the base month and day instead of clamping the full date to the bound.

members.name: clearable
members.description: Shows the panel footer containing Clear and Confirm buttons. Turning it off hides both buttons.

members.name: yearRange
members.description: The number of consecutive years per page and the step for previous/next navigation. The initial view still starts at the decade boundary of the selected or current year.

default.fallback: If rounding down yields a non-finite number or a value below 1, uses DEFAULT_YEAR_RANGE.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: The accessible name of the year panel dialog.

default.fallback: When undefined or null, uses datePicker.yearPlaceholder, whose English text is “Select year”.

members.name: update:modelValue
members.description: Emitted when an available year is selected, using the existing or current month and day at local midnight. February 29 becomes February 28 in a non-leap year. Clearing emits null.

members.name: clear
members.description: Emitted when the panel Clear button is clicked, followed by update:modelValue(null).

members.name: confirm
members.description: Confirms the current year. If the existing value is outside the visible year range, it uses the first visible year while preserving month and day and adjusting leap days. An empty value emits null.
